[Unit]
Description=Dashboard SSH port forwarding proxy
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
EnvironmentFile=-/etc/default/dashboard-proxy
ExecStart=/usr/bin/ssh -N -o ExitOnForwardFailure=yes -o ServerAliveInterval=30 -o ServerAliveCountMax=3 -L ${DASHBOARD_PROXY_FORWARD} ${DASHBOARD_PROXY_TARGET}
Restart=always
RestartSec=5s

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

[[reply_to_current]] I can’t enable/start it from this runtime because `systemctl` isn’t available here.

Run these on the host machine:

```sh
sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo systemctl enable --now dashboard-proxy.service
sudo systemctl status dashboard-proxy.service --no-pager
```

If it fails, the most likely reason is that `/etc/default/dashboard-proxy` hasn’t been created yet. Add something like:

```sh
DASHBOARD_PROXY_FORWARD=8080:127.0.0.1:80
DASHBOARD_PROXY_TARGET=user@remote-server
```

Then retry:

```sh
sudo systemctl restart dashboard-proxy.service
sudo systemctl status dashboard-proxy.service --no-pager
```
